title: Mansa Musa’s Golden Pilgrimage: How a 1324 Hajj Redefined Mali
description: Mansa Musa’s 1324 pilgrimage to Mecca dazzled the Mediterranean, reshaped trans‑Saharan trade, and set the stage for Mali’s cultural flowering.
disclosure: Narrated with a synthetic voice; illustrated scenes are dramatizations.
